reviews.title: NERF Gun for Dogs 20 inch
reviews.review_text: Our last Nerf Gun for Dogs 16 inch broke but I believe it was because the wife was putting more than one tennis ball in the chamber and it wasn't designed for that but the new Nerf Gun for dogs 20 inch states it is tennis ball friendly. Even with the over use the older 16 inch lasted a long time. I will have to see how long this new one lasts but our dogs love it.

reviews.title: Small Tennis balls,possible choaking hazard
reviews.review_text: I'm sure its great however, it doesn't use standard tennis balls. The small balls are a choking hazard for a medium sized dog.
Item quite difficult to pull back in order to shoot it doesn't shoot as far as 50 ft

reviews.title: my 2nd one
reviews.review_text: this is my 2nd one. my dog just lives this toy, so i do too. only problem i have is the trigger quit working on my first one. i have onlybhad this one 2 weeks and the trigger is already giving me problems

Just beware it makes a loud noise, “Pop” a little loud so if your dogs are skittish, then this might not be the toy for them. It shoots good, not a super long distance. You do have to pull the lever back and reload each time. It worked as advertised. So that's why I rated higher. Just too loud for my dogs who don't hand the loud “POP” each time.

reviews.title: High hopes
reviews.review_text: Don't get your hopes too high . Good for kids , elderly and maybe if had an arm injury and couldn't throw
Not bad 1st one only lasted a month the second one is still going. The bands inside snap after a lot of use.
My dog will play ball all day. Takes off running when he sees me bring this outside.

reviews.title: Cheap and breaks after few months
reviews.review_text: Breaks after 2-3 months. (On my 4th this year)

reviews.title: Too Loud
reviews.review_text: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] I give this dog toy two stars. I would say it's zero as a dog toy, but you can still use it to play with and shoot, so I give it two stars. My family has two dogs. One is a large golden doodle, and the other is a small French bulldog. The toy is so loud that it scared the golden doodle. She ran away. The French bulldog just kept barking at the toy. If Nerf can make the sound when you pull it back and then shoot it quieter, I think dogs wouldn't be so scared of it. ￼￼
